name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after age 60 for unorganized sector workers.
benefits: Fixed monthly pension of Rs. 1,000 to Rs. 5,000 after age 60.
documents_required: Mobile Number linked with Bank Account
how_to_apply: Apply online through Net Banking / eNPS NSDL portal or visit your bank branch.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for senior citizens (aged 60+) belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
benefits: Monthly financial pension directly transferred to bank account.
documents_required: Age Proof Certificate (Voter ID / Birth Certificate / Medical Certificate)
Valid BPL Ration Card / BPL Survey Number
how_to_apply: Apply online via NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in) or at District Social Welfare Office.

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS)
description: Financial assistance pension provided to widows living below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly pension support directly to beneficiary bank account.
documents_required: BPL Certificate / Income Certificate from Tehsildar
how_to_apply: Apply through NSAP online portal or District Social Welfare Department.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension support for persons with severe disabilities (80%+ disability) from BPL families.
benefits: Monthly pension assistance disbursed into bank account.
documents_required: Disability Certificate / UDID Card (80%+ Disability issued by Medical Board)
how_to_apply: Apply at nsap.nic.in or local Panchayat / Social Welfare Office.

name: PM Shram Yogi Maan-Dhan (PM-SYM)
description: Voluntary pension scheme for unorganized workers guaranteeing Rs. 3,000/month after age 60.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of Rs. 3,000 upon reaching 60 years of age.
documents_required: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account Passbook with IFSC Code
how_to_apply: Register at nearest CSC center or online at maandhan.in portal.

name: PM Kisan Maan-Dhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: Old age pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF) across India.
benefits: Minimum guaranteed pension of Rs. 3,000/month after reaching 60 years.
documents_required: Land Ownership Proof (Khasra/Khatauni Papers up to 2 Hectares)
how_to_apply: Enroll through local Common Service Centre (CSC) or maandhan.in.

name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
description: Income support of Rs. 6,000 per year to landholding farmer families, paid in 3 equal installments.
benefits: Rs. 6,000/year in 3 equal installments directly to bank account.
documents_required: Land Ownership Documents / LPC / Khatauni Record
Active Mobile Number for OTP Verification
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities.
benefits: Low premium (2% Kharif, 1.5% Rabi crops) compensation for crop loss.
documents_required: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) / Land Rent Receipt
Sowing Certificate issued by Patwari/Gram Sevak
how_to_apply: Apply through commercial bank branch, CSC, or pmfby.gov.in.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Concessional short-term credit to farmers for agricultural and farming needs.
benefits: Short-term loans up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 4% effective interest rate.
how_to_apply: Apply online via PM-Kisan portal or at any bank branch.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump Scheme
description: Subsidies for farmers to install standalone solar water pumps and solarize existing grid-connected pumps.
benefits: Up to 60% government subsidy for solar pump installation.
how_to_apply: Apply online through state MNRE designated nodal portals or pmkusum.mnre.gov.in.

name: Bihar Diesel Anudan Yojana
description: Financial subsidy provided to Bihar farmers for purchasing diesel to irrigate crops.
benefits: Subsidy of Rs. 75 per liter for crop irrigation.
documents_required: Original Diesel Purchase Voucher / Receipt (With Registration No.)
Land Ownership Proof (LPC) or Tenant Verification Form
how_to_apply: Apply online at dbtagriculture.bihar.gov.in.

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: Subsidies and financial support for fish farmers, aquaculture, and fisheries infrastructure development.
benefits: 40% financial subsidy for General category and 60% for Women / SC / ST beneficiaries.
documents_required: Land Record / Pond Lease Agreement Proof
Caste / Category Certificate (If applicable for 60% subsidy)
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmmsy.dof.gov.in or through District Fisheries Office.

name: Namo Drone Didi Scheme
description: Equips women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with agricultural drones and pilot training for crop monitoring and liquid fertilizer spraying.
benefits: Free drone equipment + certified pilot training to generate a minimum Rs. 1 Lakh annual income for SHGs.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Female SHG Member
SHG Group Registration Certificate & Membership Proof
how_to_apply: Apply through local DAY-NRLM Self-Help Group network or District Agriculture Office.

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
description: Subsidies for drip and sprinkler micro-irrigation systems to maximize crop yield per drop of water.
benefits: Up to 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers on micro-irrigation equipment.
how_to_apply: Apply online via state horticulture/agriculture portal or through District Irrigation Department.

name: PM Programme for Restoration, Awareness, Nourishment & Amelioration of Mother Earth (PM-PRANAM)
description: Promotes balanced use of chemical fertilizers along with organic and bio-fertilizers to improve soil health.
benefits: Grants and subsidies for bio-fertilizers + soil degradation reduction support.
how_to_apply: Inquire and register at local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or Gram Panchayat Agriculture Camp.

name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: Medium to long-term debt financing facility for investment in viable projects for post-harvest management infrastructure.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on loans up to Rs. 2 Crores + credit guarantee coverage.
documents_required: Detailed Project Report (DPR) for Cold Storage / Processing Unit
Land Ownership or Lease Agreement Document
how_to_apply: Submit project proposal directly on agriinfra.dac.gov.in portal.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Free LPG gas connection to women from Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
benefits: Free LPG connection along with first refill cylinder and stove.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Applicant & All Adult Family Members
BPL Ration Card / SECC-2011 Data Proof
Self-Declaration of No Existing LPG Connection
how_to_apply: Visit nearest LPG gas distributor or apply online at pmuy.gov.in.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity cash incentive for pregnant and lactating mothers to cover health and nutrition costs.
benefits: Rs. 5,000 for first child; additional Rs. 6,000 for second child if a girl child.
documents_required: MCP (Mother and Child Protection) Card with Vaccination Stamp
how_to_apply: Register at nearest Anganwadi Centre or apply directly at pmmvy.wcd.gov.in.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: High-interest government savings scheme for girl children, maturing when she turns 21.
benefits: High compound interest rate + complete tax exemption under Section 80C.
documents_required: Girl Child Birth Certificate (Issued by Municipal/Panchayat Body)
Parent / Guardian Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
Address Proof (Voter ID / Utility Bill / Passport)
Passport Size Photos of Child & Guardian
how_to_apply: Open account at any Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch.

name: Delhi Pink Pass Scheme (Free Bus Travel for Women)
description: Provides free daily commute for all female residents and students on DTC and Cluster buses across Delhi.
benefits: 100% Free daily commute across all public DTC and Cluster bus routes in Delhi.
documents_required: Delhi Residence / Identity Card (For Verification if asked)
No prior registration needed — Direct Conductor Issuance
how_to_apply: Obtain single-journey Pink Single Tickets directly from bus conductors or via One Delhi Mobile App.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Scheme (Karnataka)
description: Monthly direct benefit transfer to female heads of households in Karnataka.
benefits: Rs. 2,000 per month directly transferred to bank account.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Female Head of Family
Karnataka BPL / Antyodaya / APL Ration Card
Husband's Aadhaar Card (For tax exemption check)
how_to_apply: Apply via Seva Sindhu portal or Grama One centres.

name: Kanyashree Prakalpa (West Bengal)
description: Conditional cash transfer to keep girl students in school and delay underage marriage.
benefits: Rs. 1,000/year annual scholarship (K1) plus a one-time grant of Rs. 25,000 (K2) at age 18.
documents_required: Unmarried Declaration Form Signed by Parent
Family Income Certificate below Rs. 1.2 Lakh
Student's Aadhaar Card & Bank Account Passbook
how_to_apply: Apply through school or college portal at wbkanyashree.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Utthan (Bihar)
description: Financial assistance given to girl students in Bihar from birth through college graduation.
benefits: Up to Rs. 50,000 total cash benefit provided across educational milestones.
documents_required: Bank Account Passbook (In Beneficiary Name Only)
how_to_apply: Apply online at medhasoft.bih.nic.in.

name: Lakhpati Didi Scheme
description: Skill development and financial support for Self-Help Group (SHG) women to earn a minimum annual income of Rs. 1 Lakh.
benefits: Interest-free / Subsidized SHG loans up to Rs. 5 Lakhs + technical skill training for micro-enterprises.
how_to_apply: Apply through local NRLM / SRLM Co-ordinator or Block Development Office (BDO).

name: Mukhyamantri Ladli Behna Yojana (Madhya Pradesh)
description: Direct monthly financial support to married women in Madhya Pradesh to foster economic independence.
benefits: Rs. 1,250 per month directly transferred to the beneficiary's bank account.
documents_required: Samagra Family ID & Individual Samagra ID
Active Bank Account with e-KYC & DBT Enabled
how_to_apply: Apply through designated Gram Panchayat / Ward Camps in MP or at cmladlibehna.mp.gov.in.

name: PM Internship Scheme (PMIS)
description: 12-month paid internship opportunity for youth in India's top 500 companies with real-world exposure and monthly stipend.
benefits: Rs. 5,000 monthly stipend + one-time incidentals grant of Rs. 6,000 + PMJJBY/PMSBY insurance cover.
documents_required: Self-Declaration of No Family Govt Employee
how_to_apply: Register profile and apply online at pminternship.mca.gov.in portal.

name: Delhi Higher Education Support & Fee Waiver Scheme
description: Financial assistance and fee waivers for students pursuing higher education in Delhi state universities.
benefits: 100% / 50% / 25% tuition fee waiver based on annual family income bracket.
documents_required: College Fee Receipt & College ID Card
how_to_apply: Apply online through the Delhi e-District portal or via College Nodal Officer.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College Students
description: Financial support for meritorious college and university students to meet day-to-day educational expenses.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per year at Graduation level (Rs. 20,000 per year at Post-Graduation level).
documents_required: Family Income Certificate issued by Competent Authority
how_to_apply: Apply online via National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Female Students
description: Dedicated scholarship designed to empower female students pursuing technical education (B.Tech / Diploma).
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum directly disbursed towards college fees, books, or computer equipment.
documents_required: AICTE Approved College Admission / Seat Allotment Letter
Family Income Certificate below Rs. 8 Lakhs
Tuition Fee Receipt & Bank Account Passbook
how_to_apply: Submit application through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: PM Vidya Lakshmi Education Loan Scheme
description: Single-window portal for students to apply for collateral-free education loans and central interest subsidies.
benefits: Collateral-free educational loans up to Rs. 7.5 Lakhs with central interest subvention.
documents_required: Admission Offer Letter & Official Fee Schedule
Parent & Student Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
Income Proof / ITR Copy of Parents
how_to_apply: Register and submit unified loan application at vidyalakshmi.co.in.

name: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana (Delhi)
description: Free competitive exam coaching (UPSC, GATE, GRE, Banking, Technical) for eligible students residing in Delhi.
benefits: 100% Free coaching course fee + Rs. 2,500 monthly stipend for study materials.
how_to_apply: Apply through empanelled coaching institutes or Delhi Social Welfare Department.

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship
description: Scholarship for economically weaker students studying in class 9-12 to prevent dropouts.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per year (Rs. 1,000/month) for classes 9 through 12.
documents_required: Income Certificate from Competent Revenue Officer
how_to_apply: Apply through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

name: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
description: Education loan at highly subsidized interest rates for higher studies in Bihar.
benefits: Education loan up to Rs. 4 Lakh at 1% interest for female/PWD and 4% for male students.
documents_required: Approved College Admission Letter & Course Fee Structure
how_to_apply: Apply online at 7nishchay-yuvaupmission.bihar.gov.in.

name: Mukhyamantri Anupriti Coaching Yojana (Rajasthan)
description: Free competitive exam coaching (IAS, RAS, NEET, JEE) for meritorious students in Rajasthan.
benefits: 100% free coaching fee plus annual hostel/food allowance of Rs. 40,000.
documents_required: Jan Aadhaar Card / Rajasthan Domicile Proof
how_to_apply: Apply online via sjms.rajasthan.gov.in.

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0)
description: Free industry-aligned skill development training, certification, and job placement support for youth.
benefits: 100% Free short-term training + Skill India Certification + Rs. 8,000 stipend incentive + Job Placement Support.
how_to_apply: Register at nearest Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra (PMKK) or online via Skill India Digital Hub.

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: Promotes apprenticeship training across industries by sharing stipend costs with employers to enhance youth employability.
benefits: Government shares 25% of prescribed monthly stipend (up to Rs. 1,500/month) + On-the-job industrial training certification.
how_to_apply: Register as a candidate at apprenticeshipindia.gov.in and apply for posted opportunities.

name: Ayushman Bharat - PM Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
description: Health insurance cover of Rs. 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization.
benefits: Cashless treatment up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year at empanelled hospitals.
how_to_apply: Check eligibility at pmjay.gov.in or visit any empanelled hospital.

name: Ayushman Vaya Vandana Scheme (Senior Citizens 70+)
description: Universal cashless healthcare cover of Rs. 5 Lakh per year for ALL senior citizens aged 70 years and above, irrespective of income.
benefits: Dedicated Rs. 5,00,000 per year cashless hospital treatment cover for 70+ seniors.
documents_required: Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
how_to_apply: e-KYC registration via Ayushman App or beneficiary.nha.gov.in portal.

name: Swasthya Sathi Health Scheme (West Bengal)
description: Universal cashless health insurance for permanent residents of West Bengal.
benefits: Cashless health cover up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of Female Head & Family Members
West Bengal Khadya Sathi / Ration Card
Family Photo for Smart Card Generation
how_to_apply: Apply online at swasthyasathi.gov.in.

name: PM Bharatiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana (PMBJP)
description: Provides quality generic medicines at affordable prices (50% to 90% cheaper) through Janaushadhi Kendra.
benefits: Access to high-quality generic medicines at 50%-90% discount.
documents_required: Valid Doctor's Prescription (Signed by Registered Medical Practitioner)
No Identity Proof Mandatory for Purchasing
how_to_apply: Purchase directly at any local Pradhan Mantri Bhartiya Janaushadhi Kendra.

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Direct cash assistance to pregnant women belonging to BPL families for promoting institutional deliveries in health centers.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of Rs. 1,400 (Rural) or Rs. 1,000 (Urban) deposited into bank account post-delivery.
documents_required: MCP (Mother & Child Protection) Card / JSY Card
how_to_apply: Register at primary health center (PHC/CHC) or through local ASHA worker.

name: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana (TB Patients)
description: Direct financial assistance to all notified Tuberculosis (TB) patients for meeting nutritional needs during treatment.
benefits: Rs. 500 per month direct bank transfer for the entire duration of TB medical treatment.
how_to_apply: Automatic registration upon notification at government or empanelled private TB treatment centers.

name: Tele-MANAS Mental Health Services
description: 24x7 free and confidential mental health counseling, psychiatric tele-consultation, and support helpline.
benefits: 100% Free 24/7 tele-counseling in multiple regional languages by certified psychologists and psychiatrists.
documents_required: No Document Mandatory — Direct Helpline Dialing (Toll Free: 14416 / 1800-891-4416)
how_to_apply: Call toll-free number 14416 or access services via Tele-MANAS portal.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Support for traditional artisans and craftspeople with skill training, toolkits, and low-interest loans.
benefits: Rs. 15,000 toolkit incentive + collateral-free loans up to Rs. 3 Lakh at 5% interest.
documents_required: Active Bank Account Details (IFSC & Account No.)
Trade Proof / Certificate of Artisan Skill
how_to_apply: Register online at pmvishwakarma.gov.in or at nearest CSC.

name: e-Shram Card (Unorganised Workers)
description: National database for unorganized sector workers providing UAN and free accidental insurance.
benefits: Universal Account Number (UAN) + Rs. 2 Lakh accidental insurance cover under PMSBY.
how_to_apply: Register at eshram.gov.in or nearest CSC.

name: MGNREGA Employment Guarantee
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households.
benefits: 100 days guaranteed wage employment per year as per state rates.
documents_required: Gram Panchayat Job Card Application Form
Aadhaar Card of All Adult Applicants
Bank / Post Office Account Passbook Copy
how_to_apply: Apply for Job Card at Gram Panchayat office.

name: PM SVANidhi Scheme (Street Vendors)
description: Micro-credit facility offering affordable collateral-free working capital loans to street vendors.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan starting at Rs. 10,000 up to Rs. 50,000.
documents_required: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / ID Card issued by ULB
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in or through bank branches.

name: PM Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: Collateral-free business loans up to Rs. 10 Lakhs for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.
benefits: Collateral-free business loans under Shishu (up to 50k), Kishore (50k-5L), and Tarun (5L-10L) categories.
documents_required: Duly Filled Mudra Loan Application Form
Business Identity & Address Proof (GST / Trade License)
how_to_apply: Apply through JanSamarth portal (jansamarth.in) or visit any commercial bank branch.

name: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs. 10 Lakhs and Rs. 1 Crore to SC/ST and Women entrepreneurs for setting up greenfield enterprises.
benefits: Composite loan (Term Loan + Working Capital) from Rs. 10 Lakhs up to Rs. 1 Crore at lowest applicable bank interest rates.
documents_required: Proof of Business Premise Ownership / Rent Lease
how_to_apply: Apply online at standupmitra.in portal or visit any scheduled commercial bank branch.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana
description: Central subsidy for rooftop solar installation, providing up to 300 units of free electricity/month.
benefits: Subsidy of Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 78,000 + up to 300 units free electricity per month.
documents_required: Roof Ownership Document / Property Tax Receipt
Aadhaar Card & Canceled Cheque / Bank Passbook
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsuryaghar.gov.in.

name: PM Saubhagya Yojana (Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar)
description: Free electricity connections to un-electrified rural households and poor urban families.
benefits: 100% Free household electricity service connection along with LED bulbs.
how_to_apply: Apply during DISCOM electrification camps or at local power distribution office.

name: National Green Hydrogen Mission
description: Incentives and technological support for establishing green hydrogen plants and clean energy infrastructure.
benefits: Capital expenditure subsidies, PLI incentives, and grid connectivity support for green energy projects.
how_to_apply: Submit project proposal online through Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) portal.

name: UJALA Energy Efficient Appliances Scheme
description: Distribution of LED bulbs, energy-efficient ceiling fans, and tube lights at heavily subsidized rates.
benefits: Up to 70% discount on high-efficiency 9W LED bulbs and 5-Star rated appliances with 3-year warranty.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card or Photo ID Proof
how_to_apply: Purchase directly from authorized EESL / DISCOM distribution counters.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY)
description: Financial assistance and credit-linked interest subsidy for constructing or purchasing a pucca house.
benefits: Financial grant up to Rs. 1.2 Lakh (Rural) or interest subsidy up to Rs. 2.67 Lakh (Urban).
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of All Family Members
Sworn Affidavit of Not Owning a Pucca House
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Officer
Land Ownership Proof / Land Receipt (For Rural Construction)
how_to_apply: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or through Gram Panchayat / Urban Local Body.

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
description: Zero-balance bank account with accidental insurance and overdraft facility.
benefits: Zero balance account, Rs. 2 Lakh accident insurance, Rs. 10,000 overdraft facility.
documents_required: Voter ID / NREGA Job Card (If Aadhaar address is not current)
how_to_apply: Visit any bank branch or Bank Mitra kiosk.

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Low-cost life insurance scheme providing Rs. 2 Lakh life risk cover for an annual premium.
benefits: Life insurance cover of Rs. 2,00,000 in case of death due to any reason.
how_to_apply: Enroll through Net Banking or visit your savings bank branch.

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Affordable accidental death and disability insurance coverage of Rs. 2 Lakh for Rs. 20/year.
benefits: Rs. 2 Lakh compensation for accidental death or total permanent disability.
how_to_apply: Subscribe through net banking or submit auto-debit form at bank branch.

name: National Food Security Act - Ration Card (PDS)
description: Subsidized foodgrains through the Public Distribution System.
benefits: 5 kg foodgrains per person per month at highly subsidized rates.
documents_required: Aadhaar Card of All Family Members
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority
Residence Proof (Electricity Bill / Water Bill / Rent Agreement)
how_to_apply: Apply at local PDS office or state food portal.
